issues.display_title: Issue #1940: Fix Daily Walkthrough Video Creation Limit Check and Reset Logic
issues.main_description_html:
Walkthrough Video Daily Creation Limit & Payment Flow Implementation

Date: September 25, 2026
Endpoints Affected:

  • POST /v1/walkthrough/project
  • POST /walkthrough/project
  • POST /v2/walkthrough/project

Related Issue / Context:
Pro subscribers unexpectedly encountered a 409 Conflict error ("Daily video creation limit reached. Please try again tomorrow.") on /v1/walkthrough/project despite having only created 1 walkthrough video on the current day.

1. Problem Statement & Root Cause Analysis

1.1 The Issue

According to the GoThru subscription plan specifications:

  • Pro Plan (subscribtion 1, 6): 5 Walkthrough Videos / day
  • Agency Plan (subscribtion 5, 8): 20 Walkthrough Videos / day
  • Basic / Pay as You Go: 0 Walkthrough Videos / day

A Pro subscriber (User ID 1721) created 1 video on 2026-09-21 10:56:54. When attempting to create a second video on the same day, the API rejected the request with:

{
  "statusCode": 409,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Daily video creation limit reached. Please try again tomorrow."
  }
}

1.2 Root Cause

Two main issues were identified in app/Class/VideoAppClass.php:

  1. Monthly Query Interval Instead of Daily (DATE_FORMAT):
    The database query in getPublishedMonthlyVideo() used:

    DATE_FORMAT(date_request, "%Y-%m") = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), "%Y-%m")

    This accumulated all videos created across the entire calendar month. User 1721 had created 14 videos in September 2026.

  2. Mismatched Quota Thresholds:
    The method getVideoPublishLimit() returned legacy limits:

    // Old logic
if (in_array($subs, array(1, 4, 6))) {
    $monthlyLimit = 10;
} else if (in_array($subs, array(5, 8))) {
    $monthlyLimit = 50;
}

    Because the user had 14 videos in the current month and the threshold was 10, the check $countVideos >= $monthlyLimit evaluated to true (14 $\ge$ 10). Consequently, getPaymentStatus() returned "chargeable".

  3. Triggering Condition in PR #1917:
    Prior to PR #1917, an unintended early return (return $countVideos = ...) in getPaymentStatus() caused non-subagents to bypass the limit check altogether. When PR #1917 resolved that bug and properly returned status strings, the flawed monthly count immediately began rejecting users whose monthly total exceeded 10.

2. Solution & Code Changes

2.1 app/Class/VideoAppClass.php

  1. Updated Quotas to Match Plan Specifications (getVideoPublishLimit):

    function getVideoPublishLimit($subs)
{
    if (in_array($subs, array(1, 4, 6))) {
        $dailyLimit = 5;
    } else if (in_array($subs, array(5, 8))) {
        $dailyLimit = 20;
    } else {
        $dailyLimit = 0;
    }

    return $dailyLimit;
}

  2. Introduced Daily Interval Query (getPublishedDailyVideo):

    function getPublishedDailyVideo($vUserId, $type = '')
{
    $query = $this->databaseClass->tableVideo()
        ->select('Id', 'type')
        ->where('user_id', $vUserId)
        ->whereRaw('DATE_FORMAT(date_request, "%Y-%m-%d") = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), "%Y-%m-%d")');

    if ($type === "free" || $type === "paid") {
        $query->where('type', $type);
    }

    return $query->count();
}

  3. Replaced Monthly Count with Daily Count (getPublishedDailyVideo):
    Removed getPublishedMonthlyVideo() and replaced it with getPublishedDailyVideo(), eliminating confusing legacy monthly nomenclature and dead code.

  4. Updated Payment Status Evaluation (getPaymentStatus):
    Switched all counter calls to getPublishedDailyVideo():

    • For subagents (subs == 4): Pools the daily videos created by the agency owner and all sibling subagents under tableAgency.
    • For standard accounts: Evaluates the user's daily free videos against $dailyLimit.

  5. Persisted Video Type in addVideoRequest:
    Ensured $video['type'] is recorded during both update and insertGetId in tableVideo().

3. End-to-End Walkthrough Video Flow

User triggers POST /v1/walkthrough/project
                      │
                      ▼
         Validate Request & Token
                      │
                      ▼
   Check Subscription Allowed (1, 4, 6, 5, 8)
                      │
                      ▼
       Check Tour Moderation Ownership
                      │
                      ▼
    VideoAppClass::getPaymentStatus(userId, subs, cid)
    ├─ Get dailyLimit: Pro = 5, Agency = 20
    ├─ Count today's free videos: DATE_FORMAT(date_request, '%Y-%m-%d')
    │
    ├─► If countToday < dailyLimit:
    │      Returns "free"
    │
    └─► If countToday >= dailyLimit:
           ├─► Check isVideoPaid(userId, cid)
           │      If true -> Returns "paid"
           │
           └─► If false -> Returns "chargeable"
                      │
                      ▼
             Payment Status Handling:
    ┌─────────────────┴─────────────────┐
    ▼                                   ▼
 [payment == "free"              [payment == "chargeable"]
  or "paid"]                            │
    │                            Check Available Tokens:
    │                            tokens = getAvailableTokens()
    │                                   │
    │                    ┌──────────────┴──────────────┐
    │                    ▼                             ▼
    │             [tokens < 5]                  [tokens >= 5]
    │                    │                             │
    │           Throw 409 Conflict:            Allow Creation:
    │           "Daily video creation          $type = "chargeable"
    │           limit reached. Please          $allowed = 1
    │           try again tomorrow."                   │
    │                                                  │
    └────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────┘
                         ▼
             Filter Panoramas & Assets
                         ▼
        Insert/Update gothru_download_q.video
             (with type = free / paid / chargeable)
                         ▼
             Cache settings in Redis
                         ▼
           Response 200 OK (Video Queued)

4. Chargeable Flow Guarantee

The chargeable fallback logic remains fully operational:

  1. Under Daily Limit (< 5 for Pro, < 20 for Agency):

    • The video is created free of charge (type = 'free').
    • No token check or deduction occurs.

  2. At or Exceeding Daily Limit ($\ge$ 5 for Pro, $\ge$ 20 for Agency):

    • Status switches to 'chargeable' (unless the specific CID was already paid).
    • If the user has at least 5 available tokens, creation is allowed ($type = 'chargeable').
    • If the user has fewer than 5 tokens, the request is rejected with HTTP 409: "Daily video creation limit reached. Please try again tomorrow.".

5. Verification & Tests

Unit tests in tests/Class/VideoAppClassTest.php were updated:

  • test_get_video_publish_limit: Verifies quotas (5 for 1, 4, 6, 20 for 5, 8, 0 for others).
  • test_get_payment_status_subagent_pools_counts_without_type_error: Validates subagent pooling under the daily threshold.
  • test_get_payment_status_subagent_exceeds_limit_returns_chargeable: Validates chargeable transition when daily limit is exceeded.
  • test_get_payment_status_non_subagent_returns_status_string: Validates standard subscriber daily quota.

Description:

Investigate and fix a false rate-limit block where users encounter the error "Daily video creation limit reached. Please try again tomorrow." when attempting to generate a Walkthrough Video. In the database table video for user_id = 1721, the latest record was requested on 2026-09-21 10:50:54, showing that no videos were created on the current day, yet the daily quota check still blocked creation.
